title: Feedback: situation, behaviour, impact — and asking before telling

videos.script: Renata's first impression of Diego's reviews is that he is harsh with Thiago. {{title}} If she says that, Diego will argue. Harsh is a verdict, and people defend what they are. {{verdict}} So she looks for what she actually saw. One review comment. This is wrong, redo it. Nothing about what was wrong. {{comment}} Thiago pushed nothing for two days. Now he asks Yara for reviews instead. {{impact}} That is feedback. A moment, a behaviour, and what it caused. {{sbi}} Before she says it, she asks Diego how he thinks the review went. His answer changes what she says next. {{ask}} This lesson is about that order. Observation before judgement. Question before verdict. And soon, in private, out loud. {{timing}}
